checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate playable videos, 10s each, one 9:16 and one 16:9
must.why: Only one 9:16 video delivered; the landscape version was only offered, not made.

must.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling
must.why: Only the vertical version exists; it does show a rooftop trio at dusk.

must.item: Both versions display the three exact text lines
All three text lines inside frame and readable 3+ seconds
Compositions fill frames without bars, stretching or cropped faces
must.why: The vertical one fills the frame. The camera glide crops the musicians out by the end, leaving only a partial face at the bottom. No landscape version exists.

must.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover
must.why: The vertical video has sound at -4.2 dB peak but I can't judge its content. No second video exists.

faults.what: No on-screen text for event name, date or venue.
The camera glide ends on the skyline and loses the musicians. The last frame shows only a partly cropped face and a bass scroll.
The agent asked about text and screen format instead of delivering both versions.
Sax player and guests look slightly AI-generated, but there are no obvious limb errors.

summary: A good-looking vertical rooftop jazz clip at dusk with a smooth glide, but it has no text and no landscape version, so it misses most of the required deliverables.
